description: This file defines the 'DishIngredient' result class for a database schema, including columns, relationships, and methods for managing ingredients in a dish within a recipe or cooking application.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::DishIngredient
classes.description: A class representing the 'dish_ingredients' table, managing ingredients associated with dishes, including relationships to articles, units, and items, as well as methods for purchase list management.

methods.name: assign_to_purchase_list
methods.description: Associates the ingredient with a purchase list by creating or retrieving an item and linking it to the ingredient.

methods.name: update_on_purchase_list
methods.description: Updates the associated item from the ingredient's data if the item exists.

methods.name: remove_from_purchase_list
methods.description: Removes the ingredient from the purchase list, updating or deleting the associated item as needed.

methods.name: for_ingredients_editor
methods.description: Prepares and returns a data structure suitable for editing the ingredient in an ingredients editor UI, including available units.
